author: Philip K. Dick
card_summary: A thirteen-page scanned document gathering copies of signed letters by PKD, preserved in the archive as a collection of correspondence whose individual recipients and dates are not itemized in the record.
page_summary:
This item is a thirteen-page scanned document containing copies of signed letters by Philip K. Dick. It is preserved as a group of correspondence rather than as a single dated letter, and the archive record does not itemize the individual recipients or dates.

As an artifact, the value of a set of signed letters is both documentary and material: the signatures authenticate the letters as PKD's own, and the assembled copies give researchers a block of correspondence to work through against the published Selected Letters and the letters concordance.

Until the individual letters are attributed and dated, the entry stands as a preserved cache of signed PKD correspondence, honestly described as such rather than by any specific contents.
